items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: And, uh, on this side, in Yarlene's side, we got 150, Patriarchy 150, and Patriarchy 118.

ctx.x: We started that way. Oh, who was the band playing there when you were an altar boy? Did they have a band in the hall there?

Well, they had different bands used to play there, and, uh, but at that time I wasn't in, uh, I, I wasn't playing no music. Uh-huh. I was just going to school, you see, and I was a member of that church, you see, and by going to the school there, I began, uh, they made me altar boy. See, I was a Catholic before I joined all the Masonic organizations. After I joined each fraternal organization, I had to change my religion. So, I got into, uh, to Prince Hall Masons, Oddfellas Lodge. Well, you're a Colonel now,…

Pass one on. Okay. Here, no. One, one. Thank you very much. Thank you very much. I need you up already. Yeah, I'm good. Okay, thank you. Yeah. Yeah, so, uh, let's stop here for a minute and check if it's recording okay. Mm-hmm. We were talking about the oddballs and you were telling about even as far as Gulfport, you got the daughters.
